rule.statement: A party cannot change their position on succession in terms of section 68(2) of the Land Development Ordinance.
rule.supporting_quote: A party to an action is subject to specific constraints in presenting his case before Court. There must be consistency in how the case is presented from the original Court to the final Court. He cannot keep changing his position to suit the occasion.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 68(2) of the Land Development Ordinance
